{{Quote|If we abandon Alderaan, all hope for peace is lost.|Wynne Organa|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Wynne Organa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], serving as Chief negotiator of the peace talks in order to end the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Wynne met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] and [[Hero of Tython|his apprentice]]. He informed them that [[Aleyna Hark]] never made it to her cell, and she had been missing for hours. Discovering that she was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], she had been spotted recently entering a compound of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]].
